Q5028.reason: Recording a subdivision plat that sets a tract aside for a public school and marketing lots on that basis is a dedication, which gives the public an easement.

Q5787.reason: Shooting a gun at a person implies malice through intent to cause serious bodily injury or depraved-heart recklessness, and that malice transfers to the teammate who was killed.

Q5115.reason: At the start of exercise glycolysis accelerates and makes pyruvate faster than mitochondria can oxidize it, so lactate production rises.
